dct_title_s: Neueste Karte von Süd Africa : nach den besten quellen entworf. u. gezeichn
dct_description_sm: "An accurate and detailed map, especially of the Cape Colony and Kafferland." Insets of, the Eastern Cap Coast, District of George, Cape Peninsula and Cape Town; Prime meridian through Paris and Ferro Island. Top left: Meyers Handatlas. Top right: No. 93.
Appears in: Meyer's Neuste Universal Handatlas

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0194, p. 219
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0194.
